# Skew quadruple of order 129 from orbit_search (research/starter/skew/orbit_search.c at commit 46301162).
# Run on a laptop, 2026-11-23, one thread. All four blocks are constant on the orbits of the multiplier group of order 7 generated by 4 modulo 129; the first block is skew.
# This is a sampling search: the run reported more than 10^6 solutions and the one below is the first; it is not a census.
# The skew-Hadamard order 516 is not among the open orders of baselines/skew-gaps.json; the rows fill a cell this board had no quadruple for.
# run record:
#   orbit_search out.txt 3000000000 129 4
#   row sums of the rows below: 1, 13, -15, -11
# Checks on 2026-11-23 in code separate from the search: A skew; every block invariant under multiplication by 4 modulo 129; the Goethals-Seidel matrix G of order 516 satisfies G G^T = 516 I and G + G^T = 2 I.
# one row A,B,C,D per solution:
